title: Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March (Rosie Harris-Davison/City A.M.)
summary: Rosie Harris-Davison / City A.M.: Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March — Legal tech firm Legora has raised $550m (£410m) in Series E funding as it expands its footprint in the US, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
